title: The Agent Loop (Tier 2: its own hands in chat)

quiz.question: When the chat seat emits a tool call, who executes it and against what authority?
expect: the deterministic runtime — never the model

quiz.question: A side-effecting command is called from chat. What happens, and what is the truthful reply while it waits?
expect: waiting for the operator's confirmation, never that it ran

quiz.question: What happens to a tool call that names no registered command?
What bounds each turn of the loop?
Is 'I would need integrated tools to do that' a true statement after XIII-A? Why?
expect: described the model, not the runtime
